business_problem: Kard helps retail, restaurant and convenience brands capture new customers for life through hyper-personalized rewards. The company connects merchants and card issuers, analyzing billions of transactions to deliver targeted offers and customer insights.
solution_summary: Kard built its Databricks implementation around AI/BI, Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Lakebase. Kard helps retail, restaurant and convenience brands capture new customers for life through hyper-personalized rewards. The company connects merchants and card issuers, analyzing billions of transactions to deliver targeted offers and customer insights. AI/BI delivers business intelligence and semantic analytics over curated Databricks data. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Lakebase supports application-facing, low-latency operational serving alongside analytics. The solution also connects to MongoDB, so teams can work from a shared governed environment instead of disconnected tools. With Databricks, Kard has dramatically improved speed and scalability.

data_flow: Source data is ingested into databricks, curated in Delta Lake tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and served through analytics, semantic search, or model endpoints for downstream users and applications. It connects with MongoDB.
business_outcome: With Databricks, Kard has dramatically improved speed and scalability. Ingesting four billion transactions from a partner that once took a month now takes just one engineer an hour.
